_comment: One wish per kind of hotel found in the brochures, written in three languages. A search is right when the presentation or the reviews of the top hotel contain one of the keywords (the brochures are in French). Only cities that have at least one such hotel are counted.

wishes.fr: un hôtel pour une famille avec des enfants
wishes.en: a hotel for a family with children

wishes.fr: je veux faire la fête et sortir le soir

wishes.ru: хочу веселиться и гулять по ночам

negation._comment: Sentence encoders do not understand negation well: how often is a family hotel ranked first for a hotel WITHOUT children? (out of the 15 cities)
